sanskrit: bhos tāta kanyasa vade dvayor nāsty atra saṃbhavaḥ amoghaśukraś ca bhavān pūrvaṃ cāham ihāgataḥ
english: O father, I speak as the younger: there is no room here for the two of us. You have infallible seed, and I arrived here first.

sanskrit: śaśāpa taṃ tataḥ kruddha evam ukto bṛhaspatiḥ utathyaputraṃ garbhasthaṃ nirbhartsya bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
english: Thus addressed, Bṛhaspati flew into rage and cursed that one; the venerable seer, rebuking the child of Utathya still in the womb, pronounced his curse.

sanskrit: yasmāt tvam īdṛśe kāle sarvabhūtepsite sati evam āttha vacas tasmāt tamo dīrghaṃ pravekṣyasi
english: "Because at such a moment, while a thing desired by all beings was taking place, you have spoken such words, therefore you shall enter into prolonged darkness."

sanskrit: sa vai dīrghatamā nāma śāpād ṛṣir ajāyata bṛhaspater bṛhatkīrter bṛhaspatir ivaujasā
english: By reason of that curse the sage was born bearing the name Dīrghatamas — of the far-spreading glory of Bṛhaspati, equal to Bṛhaspati himself in brilliance.

sanskrit: sa putrāñ janayām āsa gautamādīn mahāyaśāḥ ṛṣer utathyasya tadā saṃtānakulavṛddhaye
english: That illustrious one then begot sons beginning with Gautama, in order to continue the lineage and increase the family of the sage Utathya.

sanskrit: lobhamohābhibhūtās te putrās taṃ gautamādayaḥ kāṣṭhe samudge prakṣipya gaṅgāyāṃ samavāsṛjan
english: Those sons, Gautama and the rest, overcome by greed and delusion, placed him in a wooden box and cast him into the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit: na syād andhaś ca vṛddhaś ca bhartavyo 'yam iti sma te cintayitvā tataḥ krūrāḥ pratijagmur atho gṛhān
english: "This one is blind and old and need not be supported by us" — having thought this, those cruel ones turned and went home.

sanskrit: so 'nusrotas tadā rājan plavamāna ṛṣis tataḥ jagāma subahūn deśān andhas tenoḍupena ha
english: Then, O king, the blind sage, floating downstream on that raft, drifted through very many lands.

sanskrit: taṃ tu rājā balir nāma sarvadharmaviśāradaḥ apaśyan majjanagataḥ srotasābhyāśam āgatam
english: Then a king named Bali, well versed in all duties, saw him as he was sinking, carried near by the current.

sanskrit: jagrāha cainaṃ dharmātmā baliḥ satyaparākramaḥ jñātvā cainaṃ sa vavre 'tha putrārthaṃ manujarṣabha
english: The righteous Bali, of true valour, rescued him; and recognizing who he was, that bull among men sought a boon from him — the blessing of sons.

sanskrit: saṃtānārthaṃ mahābhāga bhāryāsu mama mānada putrān dharmārthakuśalān utpādayitum arhasi
english: "O greatly fortunate one, O bestower of honour, for the sake of continuing my line, please beget upon my wives sons who are skilled in dharma and artha."

sanskrit: evam uktaḥ sa tejasvī taṃ tathety uktavān ṛṣiḥ tasmai sa rājā svāṃ bhāryāṃ sudeṣṇāṃ prāhiṇot tadā
english: Thus addressed, that splendid sage said "So be it" to him, and the king then sent his own wife Sudeṣṇā to him.

sanskrit: andhaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca taṃ matvā na sā devī jagāma ha svāṃ tu dhātreyikāṃ tasmai vṛddhāya prāhiṇot tadā
english: But the queen, deeming him blind and old, did not go herself; instead she sent her own handmaid to that aged one.

sanskrit: tasyāṃ kākṣīvadādīn sa śūdrayonāv ṛṣir vaśī janayām āsa dharmātmā putrān ekādaśaiva tu
english: In her — a woman of śūdra birth — that self-controlled, righteous sage begot exactly eleven sons, beginning with Kakṣīvat.

sanskrit: kākṣīvadādīn putrāṃs tān dṛṣṭvā sarvān adhīyataḥ uvāca tam ṛṣiṃ rājā mamaita iti vīryavān
english: Seeing those sons beginning with Kakṣīvat, all engaged in study, the valiant king said to the sage: "These are mine."

sanskrit: nety uvāca maharṣis taṃ mamaivaita iti bruvan śūdrayonau mayā hīme jātāḥ kākṣīvadādayaḥ
english: "No," said the great sage, declaring: "These are mine alone — Kakṣīvat and the rest were begotten by me upon a woman of śūdra birth."

sanskrit: andhaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca māṃ matvā sudeṣṇā mahiṣī tava avamanya dadau mūḍhā śūdrāṃ dhātreyikāṃ hi me
english: "Your chief queen Sudeṣṇā, thinking me blind and old, disrespected me, and the foolish woman gave me a śūdra handmaid instead."

sanskrit: tataḥ prasādayām āsa punas tam ṛṣisattamam baliḥ sudeṣṇāṃ bhāryāṃ ca tasmai tāṃ prāhiṇot punaḥ
english: Then Bali propitiated that best of sages again, and sent his wife Sudeṣṇā to him once more.

sanskrit: tāṃ sa dīrghatamāṅgeṣu spṛṣṭvā devīm athābravīt bhaviṣyati kumāras te tejasvī satyavāg iti
english: Touching the queen with his limbs, Dīrghatamas then said to her: "A prince of great brilliance and truthful speech shall be born to you."

sanskrit: tatrāṅgo nāma rājarṣiḥ sudeṣṇāyām ajāyata evam anye maheṣvāsā brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyā bhuvi
english: There upon Sudeṣṇā was born the royal sage named Aṅga; and in this way other great bowmen — kṣatriyas — were born on earth through brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: jātāḥ paramadharmajñā vīryavanto mahābalāḥ etac chrutvā tvam apy atra mātaḥ kuru yathepsitam
english: Born knowing the highest dharma, endowed with valour and great strength — having heard all this, O mother, do here as you wish.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca punar bharatavaṃśasya hetuṃ saṃtānavṛddhaye vakṣyāmi niyataṃ mātas tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu
english: Bhīṣma said: I shall speak once more of a means for the growth of the Bharata lineage and its continuity, O mother — listen as I tell it.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇo guṇavān kaś cid dhanenopanimantryatām vicitravīryakṣetreṣu yaḥ samutpādayet prajāḥ
english: Let some virtuous brāhmaṇa be invited with wealth to beget offspring upon the wives who were Vicitravīrya's fields.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ satyavatī bhīṣmaṃ vācā saṃsajjamānayā vihasantīva savrīḍam idaṃ vacanam abravīt
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Satyavatī, her voice faltering, spoke these words to Bhīṣma with a slight smile tinged with embarrassment.

sanskrit: satyam etan mahābāho yathā vadasi bhārata viśvāsāt te pravakṣyāmi saṃtānāya kulasya ca na te śakyam anākhyātum āpad dhīyaṃ tathāvidhā
english: "What you say is true, O great-armed one, O Bhārata. Out of trust in you I shall tell you something for the sake of the family's continuity — a matter of such gravity that it cannot remain untold."

sanskrit: tvam eva naḥ kule dharmas tvaṃ satyaṃ tvaṃ parā gatiḥ tasmān niśamya vākyaṃ me kuruṣva yad anantaram
english: "You alone are dharma in our family, you are truth, you are the highest refuge — therefore hear my words and then act accordingly."

sanskrit: dharmayuktasya dharmātman pitur āsīt tarī mama sā kadā cid ahaṃ tatra gatā prathamayauvane
english: "O righteous-souled one, my righteous father had a ferry-boat; in my early youth I used to go there to that crossing."

sanskrit: atha dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ paramarṣiḥ parāśaraḥ ājagāma tarīṃ dhīmāṃs tariṣyan yamunāṃ nadīm
english: "Then the foremost upholder of dharma, the supreme sage Parāśara, wise and intent on crossing the Yamunā river, came to the ferry."

sanskrit: sa tāryamāṇo yamunāṃ mām upetyābravīt tadā sāntvapūrvaṃ muniśreṣṭhaḥ kāmārto madhuraṃ bahu
english: "As I was ferrying him across the Yamunā, that best of sages, overcome with desire, approached me and spoke many sweet, coaxing words."

sanskrit: tam ahaṃ śāpabhītā ca pitur bhītā ca bhārata varair asulabhair uktā na pratyākhyātum utsahe
english: "Fearing his curse and fearing my father, O Bhārata, addressed with requests not easily refused, I did not dare to refuse him."

sanskrit: abhibhūya sa māṃ bālāṃ tejasā vaśam ānayat tamasā lokam āvṛtya naugatām eva bhārata
english: "He overpowered me, that child, and brought me under his sway by his ascetic power, shrouding the world in darkness right there on the boat, O Bhārata."

sanskrit: matsyagandho mahān āsīt purā mama jugupsitaḥ tam apāsya śubhaṃ gandham imaṃ prādāt sa me muniḥ
english: "There was once a great fishy smell about me that I found repulsive; removing that, the sage bestowed upon me this pleasing fragrance."

sanskrit: tato mām āha sa munir garbham utsṛjya māmakam dvīpe 'syā eva saritaḥ kanyaiva tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
english: "The sage then said to me: once you have delivered my child, you shall remain a virgin on an island in this very river."

sanskrit: pārāśaryo mahāyogī sa babhūva mahān ṛṣiḥ kanyāputro mama purā dvaipāyana iti smṛtaḥ
english: "That great sage, the great yogin Pārāśarya, was my son born of a virgin — he has from of old been known as Dvaipāyana."

sanskrit: yo vyasya vedāṃś caturas tapasā bhagavān ṛṣiḥ loke vyāsatvam āpede kārṣṇyāt kṛṣṇatvam eva ca
english: "He is the venerable sage who, by his austerity, divided the four Vedas and thereby attained the title of Vyāsa in the world, and the name Kṛṣṇa from his dark complexion."

sanskrit: satyavādī śamaparas tapasvī dagdhakilbiṣaḥ sa niyukto mayā vyaktaṃ tvayā ca amitadyute bhrātuḥ kṣetreṣu kalyāṇam apatyaṃ janayiṣyati
english: "A speaker of truth, devoted to tranquillity, an ascetic whose sins are burned away — appointed by me and by you, O one of boundless splendour, he will beget auspicious offspring upon your brother's wives."

sanskrit: sa hi mām uktavāṃs tatra smareḥ kṛtyeṣu mām iti taṃ smariṣye mahābāho yadi bhīṣma tvam icchasi
english: "For he told me there: 'Remember me when there is a task to be done.' I shall summon him to mind, O great-armed Bhīṣma, if you so wish."

sanskrit: tava hy anumate bhīṣma niyataṃ sa mahātapāḥ vicitravīryakṣetreṣu putrān utpādayiṣyati
english: "With your consent, O Bhīṣma, that mighty ascetic will most certainly beget sons upon the wives of Vicitravīrya."

sanskrit: maharṣeḥ kīrtane tasya bhīṣmaḥ prāñjalir abravīt dharmam arthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca trīn etān yo 'nupaśyati
english: Upon the mention of that great sage, Bhīṣma, joining his palms in reverence, spoke: "One who views the three — dharma, artha, and kāma —

sanskrit: artham arthānubandhaṃ ca dharmaṃ dharmānubandhanam kāmaṃ kāmānubandhaṃ ca viparītān pṛthak pṛthak yo vicintya dhiyā samyag vyavasyati sa buddhimān
english: "— artha and its consequences, dharma and its consequences, kāma and its consequences, as well as their opposites separately — and who, having pondered them rightly with his intellect, reaches a decision: that person is truly wise.

sanskrit: tad idaṃ dharmayuktaṃ ca hitaṃ caiva kulasya naḥ uktaṃ bhavatyā yac chreyaṃ paramaṃ rocate mama
english: "This that you have proposed is both in accord with dharma and beneficial to our family; what you have declared as the highest good pleases me well."

sanskrit: tatas tasmin pratijñāte bhīṣmeṇa kurunandana kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ kālī cintayām āsa vai munim
english: Then, when Bhīṣma had given his consent, O joy of the Kurus, Kālī called the sage Kṛṣṇadvaipāyana to mind.

sanskrit: sa vedān vibruvan dhīmāṃ mātur vijñāya cintitam prādurbabhūvāviditaḥ kṣaṇena kurunandana
english: That wise one, who was expounding the Vedas, perceived his mother's thought and appeared before her instantly and unannounced, O joy of the Kurus.

sanskrit: tasmai pūjāṃ tadā dattvā sutāya vidhipūrvakam pariṣvajya ca bāhubhyāṃ prasnavair abhiṣicya ca mumoca bāṣpaṃ dāśeyī putraṃ dṛṣṭvā cirasya tam
english: She then offered proper worship to her son, embraced him with both arms, sprinkled him with tears, and the daughter of the fisherman shed tears seeing that son after so long.

sanskrit: tām adbhiḥ pariṣicyārtāṃ maharṣir abhivādya ca mātaraṃ pūrvajaḥ putro vyāso vacanam abravīt
english: Sprinkling her with water and saluting her, the great sage Vyāsa — the elder-born son — addressed his grieving mother.

sanskrit: bhavatyā yad abhipretaṃ tad ahaṃ kartum āgataḥ śādhi māṃ dharmatattvajñe karavāṇi priyaṃ tava
english: "I have come to do whatever you intend. Command me, O you who know the true nature of dharma — I shall do what is dear to you."

sanskrit: tasmai pūjāṃ tato 'kārṣīt purodhāḥ paramarṣaye sa ca tāṃ pratijagrāha vidhivan mantrapūrvakam
english: Then the chief priest performed worship for that supreme sage, and he received it duly, with the proper rites and mantras.

sanskrit: tam āsanagataṃ mātā pṛṣṭvā kuśalam avyayam satyavaty abhivīkṣyainam uvācedam anantaram
english: With him seated, his mother enquired after his welfare; then Satyavatī, gazing at him, spoke the following words.

sanskrit: mātāpitroḥ prajāyante putrāḥ sādhāraṇāḥ kave teṣāṃ pitā yathā svāmī tathā mātā na saṃśayaḥ
english: "Sons are born alike of both mother and father, O sage; as a father is their master, so too is a mother — of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit: vidhātṛvihitaḥ sa tvaṃ yathā me prathamaḥ sutaḥ vicitravīryo brahmarṣe tathā me 'varajaḥ sutaḥ
english: "Ordained by the Creator, you are my first son; Vicitravīrya is my younger son — so too, O brahmarṣi."

sanskrit: yathaiva pitṛto bhīṣmas tathā tvam api mātṛtaḥ bhrātā vicitravīryasya yathā vā putra manyase
english: "Just as Bhīṣma is Vicitravīrya's brother through the father, so are you through the mother — or consider it however you will, my son."

sanskrit: ayaṃ śāṃtanavaḥ satyaṃ pālayan satyavikramaḥ buddhiṃ na kurute 'patye tathā rājyānuśāsane
english: "This Śāntanava, maintaining his vow and of true valour, forms no resolve regarding offspring nor indeed regarding the governance of the kingdom."

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ vyapekṣayā bhrātuḥ saṃtānāya kulasya ca bhīṣmasya cāsya vacanān niyogāc ca mamānagha
english: "You, then, out of regard for your brother, for the continuity of the family, at the word and commission of this Bhīṣma, and at my bidding — O sinless one —

sanskrit: anukrośāc ca bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ānṛśaṃsyena yad brūyāṃ tac chrutvā kartum arhasi
english: "— and out of compassion for all beings and for their protection, out of gentleness — what I tell you, you ought to hear and act upon."

sanskrit: yavīyasas tava bhrātur bhārye surasutopame rūpayauvanasaṃpanne putrakāme ca dharmataḥ
english: "Your younger brother's wives — comparable to daughters of the gods, endowed with beauty and youth, and desirous of sons by dharma —

sanskrit: tayor utpādayāpatyaṃ samartho hy asi putraka anurūpaṃ kulasyāsya saṃtatyāḥ prasavasya ca
english: "— upon those two you are capable of begetting offspring, my son, fitting for this lineage, for its continuation and for its progeny."

sanskrit: vyāsa uvāca vettha dharmaṃ satyavati paraṃ cāparam eva ca yathā ca tava dharmajñe dharme praṇihitā matiḥ
english: Vyāsa said: You know dharma, O Satyavatī, both the higher and the lower, and how your mind, O knower of dharma, is set upon dharma.

sanskrit: tasmād ahaṃ tvanniyogād dharmam uddiśya kāraṇam īpsitaṃ te kariṣyāmi dṛṣṭaṃ hy etat purātanam
english: "Therefore, appointed by you and keeping dharma as my purpose, I shall do what you desire — for this has been seen as the ancient practice."

sanskrit: bhrātuḥ putrān pradāsyāmi mitrāvaruṇayoḥ samān vrataṃ caretāṃ te devyau nirdiṣṭam iha yan mayā
english: "I shall give sons to your brother comparable to Mitra and Varuṇa — but let those queens observe the vow I prescribe here."

sanskrit: saṃvatsaraṃ yathānyāyaṃ tataḥ śuddhe bhaviṣyataḥ na hi mām avratopetā upeyāt kā cid aṅganā
english: "They shall observe it properly for one year; then they will be purified. For no woman without the vow may approach me."

sanskrit: satyavaty uvāca yathā sadyaḥ prapadyeta devī garbhaṃ tathā kuru arājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu nāsti vṛṣṭir na devatāḥ
english: Satyavatī said: Arrange it so that the queen may conceive forthwith. In a kingless realm there is no rain, no deities.

sanskrit: katham arājakaṃ rāṣṭraṃ śakyaṃ dhārayituṃ prabho tasmād garbhaṃ samādhatsva bhīṣmas taṃ vardhayiṣyati
english: "How can a kingless kingdom be sustained, O lord? Therefore plant the seed at once; Bhīṣma will nurture the child."

sanskrit: vyāsa uvāca yadi putraḥ pradātavyo mayā kṣipram akālikam virūpatāṃ me sahatām etad asyāḥ paraṃ vratam
english: Vyāsa said: If a son is to be given by me swiftly, out of season, then let her endure my ugliness — that is the supreme vow required of her.

sanskrit: yadi me sahate gandhaṃ rūpaṃ veṣaṃ tathā vapuḥ adyaiva garbhaṃ kausalyā viśiṣṭaṃ pratipadyatām
english: "If she can endure my smell, my form, my dress, and my body, then let Kausalyā conceive an excellent child this very day."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca samāgamanam ākāṅkṣann iti so 'ntarhito muniḥ tato 'bhigamya sā devī snuṣāṃ rahasi saṃgatām dharmyam arthasamāyuktam uvāca vacanaṃ hitam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having said this in anticipation of the union, the sage vanished. Then she, the queen, approached her daughter-in-law in private and spoke words that were righteous, purposeful, and beneficial.

sanskrit: kausalye dharmatantraṃ yad bravīmi tvāṃ nibodha me bharatānāṃ samucchedo vyaktaṃ madbhāgyasaṃkṣayāt
english: "O Kausalyā, understand what I tell you concerning the thread of dharma. The extinction of the Bhāratas has clearly come about through the waning of my fortune."

sanskrit: vyathitāṃ māṃ ca saṃprekṣya pitṛvaṃśaṃ ca pīḍitam bhīṣmo buddhim adān me 'tra dharmasya ca vivṛddhaye
english: "Seeing me in anguish and the paternal lineage afflicted, Bhīṣma gave me counsel in this matter for the increase of dharma."

sanskrit: sā ca buddhis tavādhīnā putri jñātaṃ mayeti ha naṣṭaṃ ca bhārataṃ vaṃśaṃ punar eva samuddhara
english: "That counsel depends on you, my daughter — know this. Raise up once more the Bharata lineage that has perished."

sanskrit: putraṃ janaya suśroṇi devarājasamaprabham sa hi rājyadhuraṃ gurvīm udvakṣyati kulasya naḥ
english: "Bear a son, O fair-hipped one, equal in splendour to the king of the gods; for he shall carry the heavy yoke of kingship for our family."

sanskrit: sā dharmato 'nunīyaināṃ kathaṃ cid dharmacāriṇīm bhojayām āsa viprāṃś ca devarṣīn atithīṃs tathā
english: She somehow persuaded that righteous woman by appealing to dharma, and caused brāhmaṇas, divine sages, and guests to be fed.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ satyavatī kāle vadhūṃ snātām ṛtau tadā saṃveśayantī śayane śanakair vākyam abravīt
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then at the proper time Satyavatī, having settled her daughter-in-law — bathed at the end of her period — upon the bed, gently spoke these words.

sanskrit: kausalye devaras te 'sti so 'dya tvānupravekṣyati apramattā pratīkṣainaṃ niśīthe āgamiṣyati
english: "O Kausalyā, you have a brother-in-law; he will enter your chamber this night. Remain vigilant and await him — he will come at midnight."

sanskrit: śvaśrvās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā śayānā śayane śubhe sācintayat tadā bhīṣmam anyāṃś ca kurupuṃgavān
english: Hearing her mother-in-law's words, she lay upon the auspicious bed and thought of Bhīṣma and of the other bulls of the Kuru line.

sanskrit: tato 'mbikāyāṃ prathamaṃ niyuktaḥ satyavāg ṛṣiḥ dīpyamāneṣu dīpeṣu śayanaṃ praviveśa ha
english: Then the truth-speaking sage, appointed first to Ambikā, entered the bedchamber while the lamps were burning brightly.

sanskrit: tasya kṛṣṇasya kapilā jaṭā dīpte ca locane babhrūṇi caiva śmaśrūṇi dṛṣṭvā devī nyamīlayat
english: Seeing his dark form, his reddish matted locks, his blazing eyes, and his tawny beard, the queen shut her eyes.

sanskrit: saṃbabhūva tayā rātrau mātuḥ priyacikīrṣayā bhayāt kāśisutā taṃ tu nāśaknod abhivīkṣitum
english: That night the daughter of the Kāśi king, wishing to please her mother-in-law yet seized by fear, could not bring herself to look at him.

sanskrit: tato niṣkrāntam āsādya mātā putram athābravīt apy asyāṃ guṇavān putra rājaputro bhaviṣyati
english: When he had departed, the mother went to her son and asked: "My son, will a prince of good qualities be born to her?"

sanskrit: niśamya tad vaco mātur vyāsaḥ paramabuddhimān provācātīndriyajñāno vidhinā saṃpracoditaḥ
english: Hearing his mother's words, Vyāsa of supreme intelligence — knowing what transcends the senses, impelled by fate — spoke.

sanskrit: nāgāyutasamaprāṇo vidvān rājarṣisattamaḥ mahābhāgo mahāvīryo mahābuddhir bhaviṣyati
english: "He shall be born with the strength of ten thousand elephants, a man of learning, the best of royal sages, of great fortune, great valour, and great intelligence."

sanskrit: tasya cāpi śataṃ putrā bhaviṣyanti mahābalāḥ kiṃ tu mātuḥ sa vaiguṇyād andha eva bhaviṣyati
english: "He shall have a hundred sons, all of great strength — but owing to the failing of his mother, he himself will be blind."
